projects.title: Framework Logic Analyser
projects.summary: An STM32 logic analyser with logic, serial-bus and passive CAN capture in a Framework expansion card.

sections.title: Capture interfaces
paragraphs: The card brings logic and serial-bus capture into a Framework expansion bay. Its STM32G474 supports four-channel logic and SPI capture, two-channel UART and I²C capture, and passive monitoring of CAN, RS-485 and RS-422.
The firmware documents a maximum capture rate of 10 MS/s and a buffer of 32,768 samples. Those limits describe the acquisition modes; they do not imply that every protocol runs at the maximum rate.

sections.title: Signal routing
paragraphs: Two MAX14778 multiplexers route the inputs. A TCAN3413 handles the CAN interface, while a THVD4411 provides the multiprotocol transceiver. A seven-pin connector brings the signals and power to the edge of the card.
The four-layer PCB measures 26 × 30 mm.

projects.title: uSense
projects.summary: A compact STM32 sensor board with ambient-light sensing, temperature and humidity measurement, and eight RGB LEDs.

sections.title: Sensing and light
paragraphs: uSense places an OPT3001 ambient-light sensor and an AHT20 temperature and humidity sensor around an STM32L031 microcontroller. Eight WS2816B RGB LEDs share the board.
The circular four-layer PCB is approximately 30 mm in diameter.

sections.title: Power and connection
paragraphs: The board includes USB-C, a CH343P USB-to-UART bridge, a BQ25170 charger and a battery holder.

projects.title: Tamagotchi SD Card
projects.summary: An STM32F072 board combining a full-size SD-card socket, USB-C and a seven-pin interface.

sections.title: Storage interface
paragraphs: The board pairs an STM32F072C8 with a full-size SD-card socket. USB-C and a seven-pin header provide the external connections, with reset and boot switches available on the PCB.
The two-layer board measures 44.88 × 39.27 mm.

limitations: No firmware or functional documentation found; do not infer game, emulation or tested behaviour.

projects.title: NFC Business Card
projects.summary: A business-card PCB with an NFC interface, copper antenna, two LEDs and COMP6441 artwork.

sections.title: NFC and copper
paragraphs: The V4 board places an NT3H1101/1201 NFC device and a copper antenna into a business-card outline. Two LEDs share the layout with the Andrew Chung and COMP6441 artwork.
At approximately 89.6 × 51.2 mm, the two-layer board uses its copper, mask and lettering as both electronics and the surface of the card.

projects.title: Kiku
projects.viewer_intro: Inspect the P2 enclosure, then explore the populated circuit board.
projects.summary: A portable audio design combining Bluetooth, FM radio, microSD storage and an STM32 controller.

sections.title: Audio hardware
paragraphs: Kiku combines an STM32H523VET6 controller with a BM83 Bluetooth module, TLV320AIC3104 audio codec, MAX98357A amplifier and SI4705 FM receiver. A microSD socket provides removable storage.
An ST7789 display, rotary encoder and two buttons form the local controls. The board also includes a headphone jack.

sections.title: Power and programming
paragraphs: A BQ25895 charger and MAX17048 fuel gauge handle the battery power circuit. The USB data connections feed the charger rather than the STM32; programming uses SWD.
The four-layer PCB has a nominal 60 × 105 mm outline, with component height and connector placement informing the surrounding enclosure.

sections.title: Mechanical fit
paragraphs: The P2 enclosure follows a printed P1 revision. Its main body is approximately 77.1 × 120.9 mm with a nominal skin depth of 33.2 mm; the collapsed antenna and stand bring the overall envelope to approximately 79.1 × 126.7 × 56.1 mm.
Battery, display and antenna fit still require qualification for P2.

projects.title: PCB Notebook
projects.viewer_intro: Turn each cover to inspect its artwork and layout.
projects.summary: A pair of spiral-bound notebook covers made from PCBs, with component references and circuit artwork.

sections.title: Front cover
paragraphs: The front cover turns the board surface into an electronics reference. It includes package-size examples, a trace-width gauge labelled from 0.2 to 20 mm, op-amp artwork and fields for a title, author and revision.
The package outlines are printed references on the cover. They are not populated components.

sections.title: Back cover
paragraphs: The rear cover uses copper and mask artwork for circuit symbols, including MOSFETs, bipolar transistors, diodes, switches, logic gates, passives and transducers.
Both covers are two-layer PCBs, approximately 151 × 216 mm.
